verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents its own AI agents for customer screening, ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring. These agents act on the customer's alert data inside the product by auto-remediating level 1 alerts and escalating high-risk or complex cases for human review. That is AI-driven triage rather than clearly documented insights or suggestions shown to the user, and the evidence is thin marketing-page mentions. Missing for 10: documentation of AI-generated insights, explanations or recommendations surfaced to analysts; detail on how agent outputs appear in the case UI; hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
